aism_behavior: n/a: AISM has no notation register, no generated macro file, and no declared-manifest mechanism.
notes: rk-5lzf (Tier A, LB5): `definitions/notation/macros.tex` is GENERATED from the register (`rk render macros`) and adopted under generator `notation-macros`, so Gate 7 byte-diffs it on every run. Here the register blesses `\gapfrac` as `\ensuremath{\epsilon}` and the committed macro file expands it to `\Delta` instead — the exact drift the register exists to prevent, in the one file every LaTeX source in the campaign reads. Without adoption this is invisible: the .tex compiles, every shard writes the blessed macro, and the printed mathematics silently says something else. Same failure mode as `freshness-02` (hand-edited generated file) on the notation artifact. Mutation-proven: removing the `notation-macros` entry from src/gates/freshness.ts's GENERATORS turns the finding into `unknown generator` (still red, differently), and short-circuiting the STALE comparison turns it green.
